title: Handwritten inscriptions
instructions: Carmamel Filling 2 cups brown sugar -- 1/2 cup butter, 1/2 cup cream. Put sugar and cream in the vessel you are going to cook it in pour over cream, let stand until dissolved. When cooking stir constantly to prevent burning. Try by dipping into cold water, when stiff enough to press between fingers it is done. Add a teaspoon vanilla, remove from stove and let stand until cool enough to put between layers. Lep Kuchen 2 cups brown sugar small piece butter -- creamer 6 eggs -- 1 cup mollasses 1 teaspoon cinnamon -- cloves -- alspice -- nutmeg -- ginger 1 wine glass brandy -- 1/2 glass cold water -- 1 cup each chopped citron -- almonds -- raisins -- 4 cups of flour -- 2 level teaspoons baking powder
